theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiRH_closedBall_tendsto_of_vague_plane
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ν : ℝ → Measure (Rn N)) (P : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ P = n → (∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ν r (Metric.closedBall 0 2) < ∞) → (∀ f : C_c(Rn N, ℝ), Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ ∫ y, f y ∂(ν r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ y in (P : Set (Rn N)), f y ∂μHE[n]))) → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ ν r (Metric.closedBall 0 1)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
